subject.title: fix: prevent silent message loss from EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError

question: Should PR #89039's coordinated embedded-session recovery strategy be accepted as the compatibility policy for #87180?
rationale: The code review can validate the patch shape, but maintainers must decide whether moving retries to the orchestrator and surfacing resend guidance is the desired user-facing recovery policy.

options.title: Accept PR strategy
options.body: Land after branch refresh and green CI if owners accept orchestrator retries plus resend guidance as the intended recovery behavior.

options.title: Narrow recovery only
options.body: Ask for a smaller patch that fixes silent loss and defers broader connection/timeout retry restoration to a separate owner decision.

options.title: Reject current policy
options.body: Keep #87180 open and design a different queue or retry recovery model before merging session retry changes.

recommendation.title: Accept PR strategy
recommendation.body: Land after branch refresh and green CI if owners accept orchestrator retries plus resend guidance as the intended recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent work makes this the best available owner for session-lock and auto-reply delivery policy review.
